senses.gloss: Tav, the twenty-second letter of the alphabet.—It interchanges with <cite ref="I00000"><he>ט</he></cite>, q. v.; dialectically with <cite ref="U00489"><he>ש</he></cite>, e.g. <cite ref="U00311"><he>שׁוּב</he></cite>, Chald. <cite ref="V00142"><he>תּוּב</he></cite>; <cite ref="U00174"><he>שָׁבַר</he></cite>, Chald. <cite ref="V00071"><he>תְּבַר</he></cite>.—<cite ref="V00000"><he>ת</he></cite> a preformative letter for verbal nouns, e.g. <cite ref="V00078"><he>תַּבְשִׁיל</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="B01359"><he>בָּשַׁל</he></cite>; <cite ref="V00962"><he>תְּרוּמָה</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="T00374"><he>רוּם</he></cite>; an afformative letter, e.g. <cite ref="V01034"><he>תַּרְעוֹמֶת</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="T00908"><he>רָעַם</he></cite>. Secondary verbs are formed from such nouns, e.g. <cite ref="V01011"><he>תָּרַם</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="V00962"><he>תְּרוּמָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="B00479"><he>הִתְחִיל</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="V00369"><he>תְּחִלָּה</he></cite>; or from verbs, e.g. <cite ref="V00004"><he>תָּאַב</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="A00049"><he>אָבָה</he></cite>.
